title: Between Runs
summary: Dependency phase. Tide windows replace ordinary obligations, inland relationships drift, Nicole keeps returning because the place has her too, Justin escalates, Chris mythologizes, Matt becomes territorial, commercialization contaminates the offshore district, the group cracks, and Ryan pulls away.

title: Return Tide
summary: The Big Run. Extreme low tide draws crowds. Kevin sees conditions are wrong. Justin pushes farther offshore, Matt allows momentum, Chris records, Nicole is pulled into the same run energy, the return route floods faster than expected, and Ryan disappears after turning back for stranded runners.

title: After the Water
summary: Ryan returns alive, exhausted, and quietly furious. The story spreads as content. The group cannot return to normal. Matt tries to restore authority, Justin loses the audience, Chris deletes the archive, Nicole carries her own attachment and guilt without being reduced to documentation, and Kevin states the real horror: the offshore district did not make them alive; it made them impossible to ignore.

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: A smaller, sobered group crosses during a final extreme low tide. Ryan leads quietly and Matt accepts it. The Deep district is ordinary civic life — schools, parks, homes, plazas — never inhabited. The realization: nothing happened there; humanity simply stopped arriving. They retreat inland awake but not healed.
